# T-3: Migrate test execution artifact

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Change test-execute so the runner owns project regression execution and persists test-execute-result.json version "2".

## Acceptance Criteria
- definition.js preserves test-execute → test-result-review → flow-level gate-impl ordering and updated next-action schema/context wiring.
- spec-local requirement summary entries are validated against spec-local test files, commands, names, and raw output line ranges.
- v2 schema validates summary[] range objects and the regression object.
- summary[].evidence.raw_output_lines and regression.raw_output_lines use {start_line,end_line} with 1-based inclusive raw-log lines.
- Runner-written raw start/end markers match regression.command and regression.result.
- Started command failures write valid fail artifacts; prerequisite failures do not write normal artifacts.
- registry post-hooks do not mark test-execute done on prerequisite failures.

## Implementation Notes
Keep requirement summary generation separate through a temporary agent summary artifact under tests/.raw. Delete it at test-execute start and after final v2 artifact composition, and do not list it as a committed artifact. Use a process result shape with started, exitCode, signal, timedOut, spawnError, stdout, and stderr.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for schema validation, marker validation, stale cleanup, timeout handling, and prerequisite failure behavior.
